The '''unidentified frill-backed pet''' was a creature kept as a pet on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] visited by the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]]. The creature carried its body in a horizontal position, although it walked on only its hind [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], being balanced by a heavy tail. It had a frilled back, a broad but short head, and small forelimbs. Its owner kept it on a harness when walking it.
